entry.title: New: dsh-llm-github-copilot
entry.summary: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model. Exact install spec: @lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
